name: agent-session-messaging
description: ShellPigeon: local messaging between Claude Code and Codex sessions, with optional durable mailboxes (Windows and Linux preview).

interface.shortDescription: Local messaging between Claude Code and Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Discover ordinary Windows and Linux sessions, send through Claude IPC or Codex native delegation when reachable, with an explicit Codex queue fallback. Durable pull mailboxes remain available.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me exchange messages with another local session.
